00044 #define PtrUGenProcessBlock()                                                       \
00045     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                            \
00046     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                              \
00047     float nextValue = (float)*ptr;                                                  \
00048     value_ = nextValue;                                                             \
00049     for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)                                    \
00050     {                                                                               \
00051         outputSamples[i] = nextValue;                                               \
00052     }

00056 class ScalarBaseUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
